features.name: Progressive multiplier
features.description: Every four fishermen add spins and raise the multiplier, up to 10x.

review:
Stays very close to the 2020 original: 5x3, fishing lines, dragonflies, fish scatters, and the classic collect-and-retrigger free spins with no extra layers.

Three, four or five scatters give 10 to 20 spins. The fisherman collects money symbols, and every four fishermen add spins and raise the multiplier, up to 10x after a dozen. The 2,100x ceiling is modest, which usually means a steadier ride. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
